effect_description_eng:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 of this Digimon's link cards without paying the cost.
xros_req:
[App Fusion] [Roamon] & [Effecmon]: Cost 0
If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.
link_effect_description_eng: ＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, it isn't deleted.)
